visual_identity.core_identity: A small reptilian kobold with a ceremonial caretaker role, more ritual-minded than heavily armed but still wary and dangerous.
visual_identity.silhouette: Short wiry reptilian body with a long tail and slightly bowed, reverent posture.
visual_identity.head_features: Long narrow snout, sharp teeth, alert eyes, small backward horn nubs or head spines.
visual_identity.body_shape: Lean scaled torso, thin limbs, clawed hands and long clawed feet.
visual_identity.surface: Sparse simplified scales with large open body regions suitable for coloring.
signature_gear: simple ritual sash or leather cords

accuracy_checks: small horns or head spines visible
ceremonial caretaker role reads without hiding kobold anatomy
